Salesforce Commerce Cloud is an enterprise e-commerce platform (formerly Demandware). The Master Subscription Agreement uses "commercially reasonable efforts" language with no published hard uptime target or credit structure. SLA terms for Commerce Cloud must be negotiated in enterprise Order Forms and are not publicly available — contact Salesforce directly.
